instruction: Candid documentary photograph, wide shot, high angle. In an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on the right, facing left, and touches the chest of the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) with his left hand. The woman stands on the left, facing right, looking at him. Neutral overhead lighting.

R2 receives the chest touch from R1
